note:
_ira columbae_ – wrath of the dove; der Zorn der Taube (similarly Jer 46:16; 50:16; Zeph 3:1) is now considered a translation mistake, based on Hebrew _yona_ = dove. The “dove” interpretation can also be found in Jewish medieval interpretation (Yefet ben Eli, David ben Abraham). Wissemann suggests that the correct translation would be _per iram et vim_, NVg has _ira violentiae_, but a simple _furor_ would also do (B. Lang). – Literature:
1986. Michael Wissemann: Jona gleich Taube? Zu vier Vulgataproblemen. _Glotta_ 64: 36–47.
1986. Dominique Barthélemy: _Critique textuelle de l’Ancien Testament_. Tome 2. Fribourg (xviii, *71, 1013 pp.), p. 662.
2023. Bernhard Lang: “Taube” (_columba_) als Fehlübersetzung. In: Schmid/Fieger, pp. 96–97.
